body_markdown:
Tiervâ!


Might be that I’m missing something, but super dislikes don’t seem to properly hide stories based on text matching. As you can see here, the currently active story should be hidden but still shows up in the story list. But oddly enough it doesn’t count towards the total unread for this site on the site list. Have the same problem in both web and iOS.
